subject: MedicoR - cross-border safeguards, UK addendum timeline and evidence ask
messages:
From: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@medicor.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: legal@medicor.com
Date: 2027-09-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence & timeline request for cross-border processing / UK addendum

Hi Mateo / Laura,

As discussed on the call this morning, MedicoR needs a short, prioritized list of artifacts you can commit to by next week so our legal and compliance teams can complete the TIA/UK Addendum review. At minimum we need:

- Confirmation of the SCCs baseline and any processor-flow deviations (simple summary).
- A current subprocessor list with: name, location, purpose, and data residency (onshore/eu/offshore).
- Evidence of onshore processing for any UK-designated workloads (e.g., contract clauses, subprocessors with UK-only data handling).
- Network logs / routing statement that explains whether any persistently-stored logs cross the EU/UK border.
- A redline or commentary on the UK Addendum draft we shared (legal@medicor.com).

Can you provide a short timeline (high/med/low effort) and indicate owners for each item? We have a target to complete the review by Sep 23 so procurement can sign and move to onboarding.

Attaching a list of what our team expects for evidence (requested_evidence_list.pdf).

Thanks,
Angela
Angela Ruiz
Head of Privacy & Compliance, MedicoR Health
[Attachment: requested_evidence_list.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@medicor.com>, legal@medicor.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & timeline request for cross-border processing / UK addendum

Angela — thanks for the clear list. Internal plan below with owners and an achievable timeline. I'll coordinate delivery and serve as single point of contact.

High level plan (owners + target delivery):
- SCCs baseline summary — OWNER: priyom_das — Target: 2027-09-15 (short memo).
- Subprocessor roster + locations — OWNER: laura_bennett — Target: 2027-09-15 (spreadsheet).
- Onshore processing evidence (UK) — OWNER: laura_bennett + vivek_kulkarni — Target: 2027-09-17 (contractual extracts / attestation).
- Routing & logs statement (what is logged, retention, whether logs leave EU/UK) — OWNER: neha_kapoor — Target: 2027-09-16 (technical note + sample headers).
- UK Addendum redline — OWNER: legal@redwood.com (copying priyom_das for DPA context) — Target: 2027-09-18 (first redline).

I'll attach a short internal roadmap to show milestone handoffs. We can escalate any blockers to our legal team. If MedicoR needs anything sooner we can expedite specific artifacts (e.g., a signed attestation) but that will require a few hours of legal review.

Deliverables will reference the following temporary filenames: internal-evidence-roadmap.csv, medicor_sccs_checklist.xlsx (we'll attach final checklists when ready).

Proposed mutual action plan dates (for your procurement):
- Evidence submission from Redwood: Sep 15–18
- MedicoR review and clarifications: Sep 19–21
- Final sign-off target: Sep 23

Let me know if you need a DocuSign-ready addendum draft earlier; we can drop a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal-evidence-roadmap.csv (text/csv)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@medicor.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & timeline request for cross-border processing / UK addendum

Adding a quick note — I will own the subprocessor roster and the onshore evidence packs. Initial deliverable will include:
- Full roster export (name, role, processing locations) — med_map.xlsx (will attach).
- Contract excerpt packet for UK-handled subprocessors (redacted) — will include clause citations.
- Short attestation letter template that MedicoR can accept for onshore processing claims.

Question for MedicoR: for the onshore proof do you need time-stamped operational logs from the subprocessor (e.g., access logs) or is a contractual attestation + SOC2 statement enough? If you need logs we may need a third-party consent window.

I will upload med_map.xlsx as the first deliverable.

Laura Bennett
Senior Compliance Analyst, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: med_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Tom Spencer <t.spencer@cloudops.co>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@medicor.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & timeline request for cross-border processing / UK addendum

Hi team — quick technical question from our cloud partner side: when Redwood refers to 'routing & logs statement', can you confirm whether the request expects (a) flow-level routing (ASN/IP ranges) only, (b) application-level headers (e.g., X-Forwarded-For), or (c) persistent storage logs that contain cleartext client IPs and are replicated cross-border?

From experience, customers sometimes require proof that persistent logs are kept in-region. If you expect us to provide a sample of stored logs we will need an NDA amendment and time to scrub PII.

Tom Spencer
Head of Cloud Operations, CloudOps Partner

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@medicor.com>, legal@medicor.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-13T17:56:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & timeline request for cross-border processing / UK addendum

Thanks all — summary and next steps.

1) Scope and ask we will deliver by 2027-09-18 (slightly in front of your target):
   - SCCs baseline memo (priyom_das) — 09/15.
   - Subprocessor roster + med_map.xlsx (laura_bennett) — 09/15.
   - Onshore processing evidence (contracts + attestation) — 09/17.
   - Routing & logs statement (neha_kapoor) — 09/16 (includes high-level flow diagrams, retention windows).
   - UK Addendum redline (legal) — 09/18.

2) Technical clarification: we will provide flow-level routing and retention statements and high-level sample headers. We will not provide full, raw persistent logs containing client-level PII without a specific contractual request and data-sharing agreement addendum. If MedicoR requires a sample of stored logs to validate region residency, we will need a confined scope and a signed NDA amendment with acceptance window (Tom, happy to coordinate).

3) Attachments for your intake: medicor_sccs_checklist.xlsx, UK-addendum-draft-v2.docx. These are drafts — please review and call out any non-starter clauses.

4) MAP: Please confirm if MedicoR can accept an attestation + contract excerpts in lieu of raw operational logs. If you confirm yes, procurement can proceed on the target Sep 23 sign-off. If MedicoR needs raw logs, we should set a short special-case review and plan for an extra 5 business days.

DocuSign/next steps: I will push a DocuSign-ready version of the UK Addendum once we align on whether logs are required. Link (draft): https://docusign.com/link/MDCR-ADDENDUM-DRAFT

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Manager, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: UK-addendum-draft-v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), medicor_sccs_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
